config.ripgrepPath.description: Path to ripgrep binary. Leave empty to use bundled version.
config.maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to display (1–5000). When the limit is reached the results header shows "N+" and a hint to narrow the query.
config.maxMatchesPerFile.description: Maximum number of matches shown per file in text search. Raise it to see every occurrence in files that match many times.
config.maxFileSize.description: Files larger than this are skipped by text search. A number with an optional K, M or G suffix, e.g. "500K", "1M", "10M". Larger values can slow down searches in repositories with big generated files.
config.defaultScope.description: Default search scope when Spyglass opens.
config.keybindings.navigateDown.descript: Key to navigate down in results (e.g. 'ArrowDown', 'j').
config.keybindings.navigateUp.descriptio: Key to navigate up in results (e.g. 'ArrowUp', 'k').
config.keybindings.open.description: Key to open the selected result.
config.keybindings.toggleRegex.descripti: Key combination to toggle regex mode (e.g. 'shift+alt+r').
config.keybindings.togglePreview.descrip: Key combination to toggle preview panel (e.g. 'shift+alt+p').
config.openOnSide.description: Open Spyglass in a side column instead of the active editor column.
config.closeOnSelect.description: Close the Spyglass popup after opening a result. Disable to keep it open so you can open multiple results from one search.
config.openExternalWindow.description: Open the Spyglass popup in a side editor group (detached from the active editor) and keep it open after selecting a result — ideal for keeping Spyglass visible on a second monitor. Tip: drag the panel's tab out of the window to make it a standalone window.
config.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from search and file listing (e.g. "vendor", "build", "*.min.js"). Replaces the built-in defaults. Ignored while "Include ignored and hidden files" (Alt+H) is on, except .git which is always skipped.
config.showWhatsNew.description: Show a notification linking to the changelog after Spyglass is updated to a new minor or major version. The same changelog is always available from the "Spyglass: What's New" command.
